about_the_game:
BUILD A CAFFEINE EMPIRE IN SPACE

You're the manager of a remote coffee outpost on the edge of known space.
One machine. Zero workers. Your job: turn this into a galaxy-supplying operation.

Recruit 33 unique alien workers—baristas, technicians, traders, support
units, and fighters—and watch them automate every step of production. Expand
across 6 themed decks, from the industrial Engineering bay to the VIP lounge.
Each deck multiplies your entire station's output.

RIDE THE RUSH

Every 8 minutes, Rush Hour hits. For 45 seconds, machines run at infinite
capacity and earnings double. Ships streak past as you capitalize on the surge.

When you're ready, challenge one of 8 Galactic Inspector variants in a
boss fight to earn your prestige reset — and your next build.

PRESTIGE THAT MATTERS

Defeat the Inspector, reset, and earn Prestige Tokens. But this isn't
"buy upgrades in order." You choose your path:

  • Automation Mastery – Boost trader income and offline production

  • Active Mastery – Enhance Rush Hour rewards and morale bonuses

  • Combat Mastery – Increase fighter damage and boss click power

Beyond prestige: R&D research, unit specialization trees, deck synergies,
shrines, achievement buffs, and daily streaks with random run modifiers.
Multiple interlocking systems = weeks of meaningful progression.

TAKE A BREAK — PLAY THE ARCADE

Three fully playable mini-games unlock as you expand your station:

  • Space Basketball (Deck 2) – Zero-gravity hoops with physics

  • Botanical Garden (Deck 3) – Grow and harvest alien flora

  • Pachinko (Deck 4) – Physics-based arcade with Twitch integration

THE DETAILS

Free and complete. No paywalls. Designed to be finished without spending
a cent. Optional cosmetic DLC for supporters.

Steam Workshop. Add custom jukebox tracks and unit skins from the community.

Accessible. 30 languages, colorblind modes, full controller support,
camera shake toggle.

Streamer-friendly. Twitch integration shows your viewers' names on
units in your station.

Guided by ARIA. Your station AI navigates every system with dark humor
and dynamic expressions.

Join the community on Discord so you can
vote on what gets built next.

name: Starbrew Station

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD equivalent (2.0 GHz+)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 4000+)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Mouse required, keyboard recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5 (3.0 GHz+)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (GTX 750 / RX 560 equivalent)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD for faster load times

short_description: Start with one machine. Scale to a galaxy-supplying coffee empire. Hire 33 alien workers, survive Rush Hour chaos every 8 minutes, and boss-fight your way to prestige resets that unlock permanent upgrades. Free to play. No paywalls.
